routes.title: Understand the system
routes.objective: Agree the boundary and responsibilities before discussing detailed design.

steps.question: Which actors and exchanges are inside this review?
Are these responsibilities divided at the right level?
Which declared exchanges need an interface agreement?

routes.title: Review operating behavior
routes.objective: Review the declared motor states and their subsystem context; recovery procedures remain to be supplied.

steps.question: Who can initiate the declared request?
Which events cause state changes, and what recovery conditions remain unspecified?
What does this subsystem expose to the wider system?

routes.title: Review design assurance
routes.objective: Review the capacity obligation, design structure and planned check without implying test execution.

steps.question: Is the capacity obligation agreed for this configuration?
What design information supports the declared capacity, and what needs physical confirmation?
What independent acceptance criteria, procedure and configuration evidence are still needed?
